study: On the desk's own round trips, does honoring the ratchet shelf when at least one %R line has bent improve the exit versus selling at the first shelf hit?
origin: The both-lines gate (stop_double_check_prereg.json) FAILed at -1.11 bp/trade. This sibling asks the weaker gate: sell on a shelf hit when either line is off its 10-minute high. Decline the hit only when neither line is down. Same universe, shelf, cost, and pass bar. The both-lines result is not reopened.
universe: Every ai_reports/outcomes.jsonl round trip whose entry is 09:30-15:50 ET, entry_price > 0, plan stop is 0.5% to 20% under the fill, and whose (symbol, ET day) is in ai_reports/runway_bars_cache.pkl. One row per outcome. RTH minute bars only.
shelf: Same minute shelf as the both-lines study: ai_positions.initial_local_stop then local_profit_stop once per completed minute, live config (give_r 0.12, peak leash 0.35%, decay idle 8s). This bar's low hits the prior shelf. A gap through fills at the open; otherwise at the shelf. Decay steps once per minute. Both arms share the shelf until the first declined hit.

arms.stop: Sell at the first shelf hit. Still open at 15:50 ET flattens at that bar's close.
arms.stop_and_one_line: Same shelf. A hit sells when either %R line (fast 21/7 or slow 112/3), closed minutes plus the touch price as the live reading, is off its 10-minute high by more than 0.05. A hit sells on no lookback or no live price. A hit is declined only when neither line is down. 15:50 still flattens.

cost: Gross bp per trade, (exit/entry - 1) * 1e4. Both arms pay one round trip, so a spread cancels in the difference and is not fetched. The reported edge is the paired difference, not a claim of positive absolute net.
statistic: Per scored day (>= 5 trades): mean of (stop_and_one_line bp - stop bp). day_stat from tools/studies/std_scorer.py across those days (Newey-West lag 5).
pass: PASS only if the shelf actually binds (the stop arm exits on a shelf hit for at least 30% of trades), the daily paired mean is >= +3 bp/trade, t >= 2, and at least 60% of scored days are positive, with at least 8 scored days. Anything else is FAIL and the live exit does not change. A pass is a replay result, not the G-LIVE bar, and does not by itself switch the desk.
no_retuning: Lookback 10, direction eps 0.05, fast 21/7, slow 112/3, and the pass bar are fixed. A $10+ slice may be printed and cannot flip the verdict. Do not compare against the both-lines arm inside the pass test; that arm is already a logged FAIL.
caveats: Minute bars, not the live 2-second chase. The 8-second decay steps once a minute.
runway_bars_cache.pkl is RTH only, so the slow line is unwarmed early and those hits default to sell yes.
The cache does not include sessions after it was built. Later days are absent, not zero.
Touch price is the live %R input, so a wick is judged at the shelf, not at the bar close.
